name: ImageStudio
description: Creates and edits still visuals: posters, covers, social graphics, infographics, charts and concept art. Prefers zero-call HTML/CSS/SVG for layout and typography; uses configured image models for photos, characters, paintings, textures, hybrid visuals and semantic edits.
description_it: Crea e modifica visual statici: poster, copertine, grafiche social, infografiche, grafici e concept art. Preferisce HTML/CSS/SVG senza chiamate per layout e tipografia; usa i modelli immagine configurati per foto, personaggi, pitture, texture, visual ibridi ed edit semantici.
